_source.grounding: VectorStoreIndex.from_documents over one document (MockEmbedding) and as_query_engine(llm=OpenAI).query(), the OpenAI LLM over an httpx MockTransport.
_source.recorded: 2026-11-19, offline (mocked transport, no network, no real keys), by sdk/python/tests/test_instrument.py with SUPERBASED_RECORD_FIXTURES=1

_gaps: Embedding spans name the model embedding.model_name (here 'unknown' from MockEmbedding, so the fixture states no model): base genaiattr does not read it; lane C7 maps it this batch.

Retriever spans carry their documents as retrieval.documents.<i>.document.{content,id,score}; genaiattr does not read them (its output value is output.value, a repr list). The SDK masks and drops them as extra content.
llm.prompt_template.* and llm.prompts carry prompt content genaiattr does not map; masked as extra content.

OpenAI.predict and OpenAI.chat are both LLM spans (only chat has tokens). With instrument('openai') also on, the openai call adds a third LLM span with the same tokens: rollups that sum LLM spans would double count (see the lane notes).
